bundle.shortDescription: An Android TV style television for the cab of your truck in Euro Truck Simulator 2
bundle.longDescription: TruckersTV puts a television in the cab of your truck in Euro Truck Simulator 2, bought in the game's own shop: YouTube, music, live TV and your own videos, with an Android TV style home screen. Built on WestPlay.
